title: Dataset Script Record
description: EXECUTE-stage artifact. Output of trainset-builder / testset-builder. Carries the REAL runnable dataset-construction script (code, not prose) plus the declared expected data hash and the split's freeze/augmentation policy. For split=test the schema STRUCTURALLY forbids augmentation and requires frozen=true (test-set immutability); preflight-checker re-verifies it as a hard gate.

script.description: the real runnable construction script (code), emitted as an artifact

data_hash_expected.description: declared expected data hash; preflight BLOCKs if absent before a run
